# Trident Electric Pro

> Trident Electric is a residential and commercial electrical contractor providing electrical repairs, installations, wiring, panel upgrades, lighting, EV charger installation, generators, surge protection, smart home electrical services, heater electrical work, new construction, remodeling, pool and hot tub electrical services, commercial electrical services, and multifamily electrical services.
